theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Health Care (+0.13%) and Energy (+0.13%) led the market today, while Financials (-0.22%) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.18%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.14%, defensives -0.00%, and value/cyclicals -0.04% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.32%, Dow -0.34%, Nasdaq -0.60% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.32%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 0.98% to 15.13, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.39% to $4,479.10, crude oil was little changed at $83.35, and bitcoin gained 0.83% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
